PART III – LANDSPART III – LANDS
Land Acquisition Notices
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 5

I, Kuragamage Don Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation hereby declare, under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the lands described below are needed for a public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions of that Act.

Allotments of land depicted in below names and extents in the Advance Tracing No. CO/MRT/2018/04 dated 23.01.2018 prepared by the Surveyor General, situated in the Katubedda village of Salpiti Korale, Palle Pathuwa Minor Division in Moratuwa Divisional Secretary’s Division, Colombo District, Western Province:

01. Lot A - Extent: 0.0729 Hectare North: Sri Rahula Mawatha and Battery Watta alias Delgaha Watta claimed by P.G. Anil; East: Battery Watta alias Delgaha Watta claimed by Mr. P.G. Anil and claimant cannot be found; South: Lot B, and Sri Rahula Maha Vidyalaya claimed by State; West: Sapugaha Watta claimed by Thennakoon Mudiyanselage Warnarathna & others.

02. Lot B - Delgahawatta alias Battery Watta, Asst. No. 366, Sri Rahula Mawatha - Extent: 1.3942 Hectare North: Lot A and Battery Watta alias Delgahawatta claimant cannot be found; East: Bolgoda River; South: Cement drain, Dandeniya Watta claimed by State, Access road and Lot C; West: Lot C.
03. Lot C - Extent: 0.0735 Hectare North: Lot A and B; East: Lot B and Access road; South: Access road and cut drain; West: Cut drain and Sri Rahula Maha Vidyalaya claimed by State.
K. D. Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation.
My No.: 4-3/11/2017/UD/500.Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation,“Mihikatha Medura”,1200/6, Rajamalwatta Road, Battaramulla.24th July, 2025.
